title: Composition Rules exposed legacy live PROJECT Workspace creation in ADMIN
before: The ADMIN Composition Rules canonical route resolved AdminConfigurationView and its live Workspace creation form; POST /api/v1/admin-configuration/workspaces created PROJECT status=active without Project Creation/Initialization.
after: Canonical route resolves the existing AdminEnterpriseStructurePage rules editor; explicit initialTab survives remote load. Backend remediation is owned by uat_backend_inventory and denies PROJECT bypass with 409 PROJECT_CREATION_PROCESS_REQUIRED.
releaseImpact: Blocking until backend negative regression and scoped remediation are validated; frontend tests alone do not close backend security.
removedDataOrCode: None; strategic renderer rewired, legacy branch retained for deliberate deprecation.

title: Periodic Portfolio Review appeared before its Scenario Convergence predecessor
before: USER Review was a phase4 child, displayed before phase5 scenario planning although predecessorIds already named scenario-convergence-recommendation.
after: USER Review and detail views are phase5/order4 after Scenario Convergence; landing derives its review button from the same blueprint longitudinal metadata. URLs, business names and eight phases are preserved. ADMIN review policy remains a reusable prerequisite in phase4.
releaseImpact: No independent decision authority changed. Focused metadata/DOM regression required; no business sign-off claimed.

title: Governance applicability helper is not a runtime navigation filter
actual: Production callers do not invoke strategicNodeApplies. The metadata test proves a helper result, not contextual menu hiding or backend permission enforcement.
workaround: Use published backend eligibility and allowed_actions; do not infer mandatory CAPITAL_OWNER governance for Contractor/Direct from menu presence.
recommendedAction: Clarify contextual discoverability contract during release hardening; do not use UI helper as security authority.

title: Eleven Business Case legacy renderers are outside canonical route registry
actual: Historical names remain in renderer/type/view-map contracts, but strategicNodeForView has no canonical node and the outlet returns null. Duplicate initial assignment of the BC renderer group is overwritten by the dedicated onNavigate loop.
workaround: Use canonical Five Case Business Case routes only, as listed in frontend_guide_routes.md.
recommendedAction: Confirm old external deep-link consumers and deprecation/redirect requirements before removal. No business capability missing has been inferred.

title: Enterprise Explorer READ_ONLY_SHARED metadata understates embedded USER transactions
actual: Explorer classification is READ_ONLY_SHARED while the USER screen hosts live Project Creation and review navigation. It is not an ADMIN configuration control leak; transaction authority remains backend-controlled.
workaround: Administration/User guide explicitly describes creation and lifecycle actions as USER operations under Explorer.
recommendedAction: Align classification semantics with the composite screen after agreeing whether the classification describes the landing or all embedded operations.
